judge.rationale: The candidate diff only adds `.lore/dod.md` and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code, types, validation, specs, or documentation changes. In the test file, it even has to use module augmentation (`declare module './createServer.js'`) because `history` was never added to `HalServerOptions`. Because none of the actual feature exists, the new acceptance tests will fail immediately at runtime when sending `list_conversations` frames. Every production requirement and acceptance criterion in the issue was left unimplemented.
